name: com.microsoft.identity.common.internal.providers.oauth2.SwitchBrowserRedirectActivity
description: Microsoft's shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library uses this Activity to receive the browser redirect for apps that enable browser-switch sign-in, then reopens the in-app authorization flow with the returned data.
disableEffect: The browser-switch response cannot return to the app's authorization flow, so that sign-in request may fail or remain unfinished.
